desc: 向日黄撞色底，原料摆拍与膏体微距，配空位主张清单的唇部护理套组
name: 明黄撞色水润护唇膏款

shots.intent: 在搜索结果页一眼看清多支组合与开盖露出的膏体，抢首次点击。
一秒传达可挂陈多支随身的购买理由，承接首图的价值感。
shots.textZone: upper right corner block for one headline placeholder

shots.intent: 用天然质料道具与左侧留空主张位解释配方逻辑，讲清为什么保湿。
shots.textZone: left third column, three stacked headline-plus-subline blocks

shots.intent: 让买家把自己代入外出随时补涂的真实时刻，建立使用直觉。
用膏体摊涂的厚润纹路做物证，替留空主张位提供可信视觉。
shots.textZone: top-left, top-right and bottom-centre blank label slots

shots.intent: 用情感认同与干净光泽的唇部状态拉近距离，为收口铺垫。
shots.textZone: left panel headline block plus blank body rules

shots.intent: 一屏摊开可选色系，让买家自行比较并选规格。
以四行留空图标位与空白印章框承接主张与凭证，消除下单顾虑。
shots.textZone: header band plus four stacked blank icon rows and one empty seal frame

style.backgroundSystem: flat saturated sunflower-yellow #F5C400 graphic field for story, texture and variant screens, seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshots, cream #F7EEDC panel blocks for info screens, one sunlit outdoor foliage-bokeh exception for the lifestyle screen
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line glyphs in charcoal #3A2A1E seated in blank rounded chip rows with empty label slots
style.lightingSystem: bright soft studio light, front-left key with wrap fill, 5200-5600K on graphic screens, low contrast with soft single-direction contact shadows, no harsh speculars, one hard direct-sunlight exception on the outdoor screen
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm natural lip-care ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of saturated sunflower-yellow field #F5C400, cream off-white panel #F7EEDC, charcoal-brown text #3A2A1E and one brick-red accent #C0362C; warm color temperature; flat single-colour graphic background for story screens plus seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshots; bright soft studio lighting with a front-left key, wrap fill and soft single-direction contact shadows, no harsh speculars; modern geometric sans-serif throughout with a bold uppercase headline over a lighter lowercase sub-line; thin single-weight line icons inside blank rounded chip rows; short twist-tube products shown upright and stable at consistent scale with the label face to camera; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no brand wordmark or source packaging art
style.presentationRules: short twist tube kept upright at consistent scale with cap end up and the label face toward the camera, only one new camera angle per screen, no packaging artwork redraw
style.surfaceSystem: matte seamless paper sweep and smooth cream laminate panel #F7EEDC, no wood or stone grain, no reflective table mirror
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif only, bold uppercase headline plus lighter lowercase sub-line, generous line spacing, left-aligned copy column, all wording supplied as placeholder slots
